CustomField.description: How often the service charge is billed. Divides the annual (Rate x Area) amount by 12 and multiplies by the number of months in this frequency (Annual=12, Semi-Annual=6, Quarterly=3) in RES_ResidentialBundlePricingHook.computeServiceCharge. Blank defaults to Annual (unchanged legacy behavior) for backward compatibility with existing records.
CustomField.label: Billing Frequency
